title: Derived representative transport through coefficient equivalence
statement: For the data of the finite-model derived scalar comparison, let K be the restriction along ρ⁻¹ of the canonical complex representative of L(Q(P)). Then the finite constant model over D of the composite scalar extension of P is isomorphic in the derived category over D to the finite constant model over D of K.

source.place: Tags 0D6D and 093J; derived pullback composition and exact coefficient transport

proof.text: Use the IsLeftDerivedFunctor universal property of L to identify its value on Q(P) with the derived extension-of-scalars representative along q.

Restriction along the ring equivalence inverse is exact and transports the representative. Derived scalar transitivity and the termwise universe-lift comparison identify the resulting D-complex with the composite scalar extension model.
